verdict.rationale: React's own docs describe a data-driven model: components receive data and return UI, and when new data is passed in after an interaction, React updates the screen to match. This implies an explicit flow from data to view rather than implicit bindings. React Developer Tools let developers inspect and edit props and state, which supports tracing state. missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-way/unidirectional data flow or contrast with two-way binding, evidence on tracing state changes over time, independent or hands-on corroboration of predictability.
